articles.title: Meta will record employees’ keystrokes and use it to train its AI models
articles.summary: Meta says that it has a new internal tool that is converting mouse movements and button clicks into data that can train its AI models.

articles.title: Unauthorized group has gained access to Anthropic’s exclusive cyber tool Mythos, report claims
articles.summary: Anthropic told TechCrunch it is investigating the claims, but maintains that there is no evidence that its systems have been impacted.

articles.title: SpaceX is working with Cursor and has an option to buy the startup for $60B
articles.summary: The move could shore up weaknesses at each company, but it also reveals them. Neither Cursor nor xAI has proprietary models that can match the leading offerings from Anthropic and OpenAI — the same companies now competing directly with Cursor for the developer market.

articles.title: Apple’s John Ternus will run one of the world’s most powerful companies; the job is a minefield
articles.summary: Apple's top job comes with almost unrivaled power and money, but it comes with plenty of baggage, too.

articles.title: AI research lab NeoCognition lands $40M seed to build agents that learn like humans
articles.summary: Founded by an OSU researcher, the startup is developing AI agents that can become experts in any domain.

articles.title: ChatGPT’s new Images 2.0 model is surprisingly good at generating text
articles.summary: ChatGPT Images 2.0, the newest image-generation model from OpenAI, shows just how much AI capabilities have evolved over the last few years.

articles.title: Sam Altman throws shade at Anthropic’s cyber model, Mythos: ‘fear-based marketing’
articles.summary: This week, during a podcast appearance, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman called out his competitor's new cybersecurity model, noting that the company was using fear to make its product sound more impressive than it actually is.

articles.title: Clarifai deletes 3 million photos that OkCupid provided to train facial recognition AI, report says
articles.summary: The photo deletion comes after an FTC settlement with Clarifai. The company had asked OkCupid — whose executives had invested in Clarifai — to share data in 2014, according to court documents.

articles.title: AI Dungeon maker Latitude unveils Voyage, a platform for creating AI-powered RPGs
articles.summary: Latitude's new AI-native platform, Voyage, aims to help gamers create their very own role-playing game.

articles.title: Bond, a new social media platform, wants to use AI to help you kick your doomscrolling habit
articles.summary: Bond wants you to get off the couch and get back into the real world, its creator says. The new platform's AI system is designed to motivate users to do things away from the app.

articles.title: YouTube expands its AI likeness detection technology to celebrities
articles.summary: YouTube is expanding its AI likeness detection tool to celebrities, giving talent and their reps a way to find and remove deepfakes.

articles.title: GRAI believes AI can make music more social, not replace artists
articles.summary: AI music startup GRAI says fans want to remix tracks, not generate songs from scratch.

articles.title: Anthropic takes $5B from Amazon and pledges $100B in cloud spending in return
articles.summary: Amazon has made another circular AI deal: It's investing another $5 billion in Anthropic. Anthropic has agreed to spend $100 billion on AWS in return.

articles.title: Google rolls out Gemini in Chrome in APAC countries
articles.summary: Google is rolling out Gemini in Chrome in Australia, Indonesia, Japan, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, and Vietnam. The company is rolling this feature out to both desktop and iOS in all of these countries except Japan.

articles.title: It’s not just one thing — it’s another thing
articles.summary: This sentence construction ("It's not just this — it's that") has become so common in AI-generated writing that it's no longer just a clue that a piece of writing may be synthetic — it's almost a guarantee.

articles.title: NSA spies are reportedly using Anthropic’s Mythos, despite Pentagon feud
articles.summary: NSA is said to be using Anthropic's restricted Mythos AI model.

articles.title: CEO and CFO suddenly depart AI nuclear power upstart Fermi
articles.summary: The startup, co-founded by former U.S. Energy Secretary Rick Perry, has faced headwinds with its AI campus in Texas.

articles.title: OpenAI’s existential questions
articles.summary: On the latest episode of Equity, we discuss OpenAI's latest acquisitions and whether they address "two big existential problems" for the company.

articles.title: The 12-month window
articles.summary: A lot of AI startups exist partly because the foundation models haven't expanded into their category yet. As many jokingly acknowledge, that won't last forever.

articles.title: Palantir posts mini-manifesto denouncing inclusivity and ‘regressive’ cultures
articles.summary: Palantir's ideological bent has come under more scrutiny as it's worked with ICE and positioned itself as a defender of "the West."

articles.title: EQT, Omers to increase investment in struggling broadband provider Deutsche Glasfaser - report
articles.summary: Deutsche Glasfaser currently has debts of more than €7bn

articles.title: Meta breaks ground on data center in Tulsa, Oklahoma
articles.summary: Will be company's first data center in the state

articles.title: Amazon inks $30m carbon removal deal with the Good Rice Alliance in India - report
articles.summary: Purchases more than 685,000 tons of credits as part of deal

articles.title: DCD>Studio: Boundary free AI infrastructure with Valerie Crafton, Mod42
articles.summary: DCD’s Kat Sullivan speaks with Valerie Crafton of Mod42 on boundary free AI infrastructure and how modular delivery is reshaping speed to deployment across next generation data center builds.

articles.title: Sponsored: From backup to system stability: Rethinking the role of batteries in AI data center power architecture
articles.summary: Batteries are evolving from backup assets into active components of a broader energy ecosystem

articles.title: DataBank secures $2bn construction financing for Dallas data centers
articles.summary: Company has raised $4.7 billion in the last 12 months

articles.title: Switch secures $2.6bn credit facility to fuel transmission and generation for data centers
articles.summary: Company says syndicated performance letter of credit facility is first for data center sector

articles.title: ECL plans 35MW data center in California that will use some hydrogen power
articles.summary: Grid energy will also supply Santa Clara facility

articles.title: Meta signs up to 1GW supply deal with long duration energy storage firm Noon Energy
articles.summary: Its first deal within the long duration storage space

articles.title: Meta partners with CBRE to train data center technicians in the US for free
articles.summary: Successful graduates will go on to work at Meta data centers

articles.title: OVHcloud brings Quandela's Belenos quantum computer to cloud platform
articles.summary: OVH's quantum cloud platform launched in November 2025

articles.title: Automaker Stellantis aims to reduce data center footprint by 60%, migrates to Microsoft Azure
articles.summary: Stellantis and Microsoft sign five-year agreement to support migration

articles.title: Google confirms plans for data center in LaGrange, Georgia
articles.summary: Company linked to project earlier this month after Fire Department rescued worker from data center roof

articles.title: Uravu's salty solution to the data center cooling conundrum
articles.summary: System can chill racks and harvest heat

articles.title: Plans to build 1,300-acre data center in Fort Meade, Florida, gets go-ahead from officials
articles.summary: But still needs final approval from water utility

articles.title: NTT decommissions data center outside London
articles.summary: Facility inherited from Gyron in Hemel Hempstead retired, environmental permit surrendered

articles.title: Officials in North Carolina County give ok for rezoning, potential data center incoming
articles.summary: Natelli Investments back with new project: Company hasn’t provided details, residents unhappy

articles.title: Bull announces €30m, five-year contract for Mimer supercomputer in Sweden
articles.summary: System was procured by the EuroHPC JU and housed at the University of Linköping

articles.title: ST Telemedia Philippines inks 40MW renewable supply deal with MPower
articles.summary: Will deliver power to three of its facilities

articles.title: Australia’s Viridis secures Sydney site for data center
articles.summary: Construction estimated to begin this year

articles.title: Kentucky utilities eye 266-MW pumped storage project as demand drives renewed interest
articles.summary: Two PPL utilities — Louisville Gas and Electric and Kentucky Utilities — are studying the project. But at about $4.9 million/MW, it doesn’t appear viable without a data center hyperscaler willing to pay for it, Jefferies analysts said.

articles.title: Virginia public power providers embrace megawatt-scale, distribution-connected batteries
articles.summary: Deploying multiple small batteries — in this case, five projects of 5 MW each — is faster and cheaper than transmission-connected projects and provides many of the benefits of a virtual power plant, the developer told Utility Dive.

articles.title: Minnesota got one thing right on distributed storage — but it missed the bigger opportunity
articles.summary: Xcel Energy’s 200-MW, ratepayer-funded battery pilot is not the right model to encourage broad adoption, writes Coalition for Community Solar Access CEO Jeff Cramer.

articles.title: Rivian, Redwood Materials announce energy storage partnership
articles.summary: The EV maker’s second-life battery packs will be integrated into an energy system for its Illinois assembly plant.

articles.title: New England states urge FERC to advance $1.5B in ratepayer refunds
articles.summary: Governors and utility regulators asked the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to dismiss a request by Eversource and Avangrid to stay the refund order while a court weighs an appeal. The dispute has already spawned 15 years of litigation.

articles.title: Sudden data center load losses prompt NERC alert, recommendations
articles.summary: The reliability watchdog is concerned about a series of “widespread and unexpected” customer-initiated load reductions in 2024 and 2025 during which 1,000 MW or more dropped off the bulk power system.

articles.title: La Plata Electric CEO: Why Western utilities are moving toward regional markets
articles.summary: Following its transition into the Southwest Power Pool, LPEA expects an immediate reduction in greenhouse gas emissions of roughly 20%, along with reduced wholesale power costs, writes Chris Hansen.

articles.title: MISO expects load to jump 35% by 2035 on data center growth
articles.summary: However, data center development plans "widen uncertainty" in the long-term outlook, the Midcontinent Independent System Operator cautioned. Utilities need more dynamic planning models to cope, Stephanie Chesnick Cutter of EY told Utility Dive.

articles.title: Fleet managers not sold on EVs, but they’re getting there: survey
articles.summary: Insufficient options for larger trucks and nervousness about range and charging options are holding back adoption, says EV services company Mitra. About a third of states have adopted zero-emission fleet requirements, including some for private organizations.

articles.title: The grid is under pressure from two directions. Your customers own the answer.
articles.summary: AI is straining the bulk system. EVs are stressing local feeders. Flexibility can solve both.

articles.title: Study highlights opportunities for Dutch nuclear supply chain
articles.summary: With the Dutch province of Zeeland under consideration as the location for two new nuclear power plants, a new report says local businesses could capture up to EUR4.6 billion (USD5.4 billion) in direct economic value during the 12-year construction period.

articles.title: New Korean reactor cleared for start up
articles.summary: South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission said it has completed all nine inspections required to be performed prior to the reactor's initial criticality during the pre-operation inspection of Saeul unit 3.

articles.title: Contract signed for delivery of UK's first SMRs
articles.summary: Rolls-Royce SMR and Great British Energy - Nuclear have signed a contract that enables work to start immediately on the delivery of three Rolls-Royce small modular reactors at Wylfa, on the island of Anglesey, North Wales. In addition, the National Wealth Fund is committing up to GBP599 million (USD805 million) to Rolls-Royce SMR to support the dev

articles.title: First-of-a-kind microreactor test bed open for business
articles.summary: The Demonstration of Microreactor Experiments test bed - built from the repurposed Experimental Breeder Reactor-II facility at Idaho National Laboratory - is now ready to host its first fuelled microreactor test campaign.

articles.title: Third unit at Korea's Saeul plant starts up
articles.summary: Unit 3 at the Saeul nuclear power plant has attained a sustained chain reaction for the first time, Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power announced. It is the third of four APR-1400 reactors that have begun operating at the site.

articles.title: US Air Force names potential SMR hosts
articles.summary: Buckley Space Force Base in Colorado and Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana have been selected by the US Department of the Air Force as potential locations to site microreactors under the Advanced Nuclear Power for Installations programme.

articles.title: Outer dome installed at Changjiang unit 4
articles.summary: The outer steel dome has been installed at unit 4 of the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's Hainan province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Rosatom 'ready to answer all Paks II questions'
articles.summary: Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev has said they are ready to discuss any questions the incoming Hungarian government has about the Paks II nuclear power plant project.

articles.title: Application lodged to build microreactor at US university
articles.summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission announced it has received an application from the University of Illinois to construct the first research KRONOS micro modular reactor on the university's campus.

articles.title: Bulgarian minister wants fixed price for Kozloduy 7 and 8
articles.summary: Minister of Energy Traycho Traykov has said Bulgaria wants its proposed new nuclear power units at the Kozloduy plant to be built at fixed prices.

articles.title: Dutch agreement paves way for construction of commercial MSR
articles.summary: A memorandum of understanding has been signed for the construction of a non-nuclear demonstrator Thorizon molten-salt reactor in the Dutch province of Zeeland, a nuclear demonstrator at Petten, Noord-Holland, followed by the first commercial unit in Zeeland.

articles.title: First Taipingling unit enters commercial operation
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the Taipingling nuclear power plant has entered commercial operation, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Guangdong province.

articles.title: OSGE and development agency sign agreement for Polish SMR project
articles.summary: Poland's Orlen Synthos Green Energy has signed a letter of intent with the country's Industrial Development Agency to collaborate on the preparation for the construction and operation of small modular reactors at the Strategic Investment Park in Stalowa Wola.

articles.title: Kairos breaks ground for Hermes 2 reactor
articles.summary: The Hermes 2 Demonstration Plant in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, will be the company's first commercial-scale reactor and is the first power-producing Gen IV reactor to receive a construction permit from the US regulator.

articles.title: First new Kursk unit 'ready for commercial operation'
articles.summary: The first VVER-TOI unit at the Kursk II Nuclear Power Plant in Russia has successfully completed pilot operation and is ready for commercial operation, Rosatom says.

articles.title: Grants allocated for Swedish feasibility studies
articles.summary: The Swedish Environmental Protection Agency has distributed SEK19.8 million (USD2.2 million) to nine municipalities that have applied to carry out feasibility studies for new nuclear power.

articles.title: Westinghouse sets standards to support fleet-scale AP1000 deployment
articles.summary: Westinghouse Electric Company's submittal to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission seeks to incorporate lessons learned from the construction of Vogtle units 3 and 4 into the design control document and establishes Vogtle 4 as the standard AP1000 reference plant for deployment in the USA.

articles.title: Commission calls for Norway to prepare for nuclear energy
articles.summary: The Norwegian Nuclear Commission has recommended that the government does not start a process for nuclear power development in the country at this stage, but says it should prepare for its possible future use.

articles.title: Three US states pave way for new nuclear
articles.summary: Legislation lifting a long-standing nuclear moratorium has been signed in New Jersey; legislation to incentivise nuclear construction has been signed in Kentucky; and in Texas, applications have opened for USD350 million of funding appropriated by the state to boost advanced nuclear construction.

articles.title: Swedish state to take stake in nuclear development firm
articles.summary: The Swedish government said it plans to take a majority stake in nuclear project development company Videberg Kraft AB and to take a role in financing the future system for the disposal of radioactive waste and used nuclear fuel.
